item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 04/Oct/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Tropical Cyclone Matmo will move across the central and northern parts of the South China Sea today and tomorrow, in the general direction of the vicinity of Leizhou Peninsula and the eastern part of Hainan Island, and intensify gradually. There are uncertainties in its intensity. Under its influence, it will be windy with squally showers over the coast of southern China later today to tomorrow. Seas will be rough with swells. With Matmo departing and dissipating gradually, the weather will improve over the coast of Guangdong on the Mid-Autumn Festival and the day after. An anticyclone aloft is expected to cover southern China in the middle and latter parts of next week, and a broad trough of low pressure will bring a few showers to the central and northern parts of the South China Sea.
